purpose: Standing tripwire data for entry 54's curvature falsifier. Entry 54 (bounce paper 2505.23877) predicts a CLOSED universe, Omega_k < 0, and refutes on 'a confirmed Omega_k > 0' (an OPEN universe). This ledger holds the current-best spatial-curvature constraints; b63_standing_curvature_tripwire.py recomputes the verdict from it on every battery run. B61 (2026-08-30, agy+codex) established these values and the NOT-FIRED verdict.
convention: Omega_K > 0 = OPEN = ADVERSE to entry 54's closed prediction; Omega_K < 0 = CLOSED = the prediction. Verified in B61 from the paper's own Eq.27 and DESI's sinh distance branch.
threshold_rationale: Below 3 sigma = a hint (current state). At >= 3 sigma open-side, the tension crosses from 'hint' to 'significant preference' and the tripwire FAILS the battery to force a re-gate (a fresh two-seat B-gate) that decides whether it meets entry 54's 'confirmed' bar (~5 sigma = a detection). The tripwire does NOT itself fire the falsifier or change any tier -- it halts and demands adjudication, which is a Duho decision.
closed_limb_note: A secondary, CONDITIONAL refutation exists: Omega_k <= -0.09 confirmed refutes only under the authors' own chi_* identification. Tracked but currently far off (nearest closed value is Planck's -0.0106).
how_to_update: When a new DESI/Planck/ACT curvature result lands, add its {source, dataset, omega_k, sigma} here and re-run the battery. If the tripwire FAILS, run a fresh two-seat gate and bring the result to Duho -- do not silently edit the threshold or delete a constraint to make it pass.
